title: Restraint

D0.outcome: Explains restraint as stopping an enemy pawn break before it happens: first restrain, next blockade, lastly destroy.

D1.outcome: Chooses the set-up that restrains a given mobile pawn or majority and names the break it prevents.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, decides whether the break is real enough to justify a restraining set-up such as a rook on a still-closed file.

D3.outcome: Predicts when restraint stops working against a break whose time has come.

misconceptions: A rook belongs on an open file at once, never on a closed one.
conditions: The enemy pawn break is real, and the structure allows the set-up.
contrasts: Restraint cannot hold forever against a freeing move whose time has come.
A rook on a closed file with no break to deter.
